name: open-artifact
description: Make slide decks, design canvases, whiteboards, spreadsheets, data dashboards, docs and design systems as folders of files that open in one local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports; comments sent from the page come back to the agent. Runs locally on Node.js 22 or later.

interface.shortDescription: Decks, designs, boards, sheets, dashboards and docs you comment on
interface.longDescription: Make slide decks, design canvases, whiteboards, spreadsheets, data dashboards, docs and design systems as folders of files that open in one local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports; comments sent from the page come back to the agent. Runs locally on Node.js 22 or later.
defaultPrompt: /open-artifact slides a 6-slide pitch for this project
/open-artifact data a dashboard of this CSV
